title: PAH-OMC-020 source-owned C2(A) second-rate-moment contract
question: Do the unchanged PAH-001 midpoint rates and normalized Gibbs state imply a family-uniform local second-rate-moment bound C2(A) on the registered OMC-010 path?
finding: Yes at the exact local-form level. Squaring the unchanged midpoint rate moves the Gibbs factor to the inverse-root image: pi(x)c_r(x)^2=Z^-1 m_r(x)^2 exp(-beta F(r x)). Since every declared PAH mobility obeys m_r<=1 and the inverse root is injective, each directed root contributes at most one. R-490's N_geom=60 per-vertex support-incidence bound then gives C2(A)<=60|A| for every finite cylinder support A, uniformly in n>=2 and R_max>=1 on the OMC-010 path.
decision_reason: This closes the precise second-rate-moment input requested by R-521 without changing PAH-001 or inventing a carrier. It distinguishes the PAH-specific mobility cap from the abstract two-state sufficiency witness, whose effective mobility exceeds one. The induced Cauchy-Schwarz estimate controls Lf in local Gibbs L2 but does not construct the temporal process.
